blocks.text: The Brazilian Side of Iguazu Falls

provenance.rationale: Selected the Brazilian part of the approved Word two-sided itinerary heading for this dedicated day title.

blocks.text: After breakfast, your guide picks you up for the Brazilian side of the falls. A calm walk along the edge of the canyon reveals one of the most spectacular views on Earth, with some 275 cascades and rainbows shimmering in the spray, leading to the largest waterfall in the park, the Devil’s Throat, where the water plunges some 80 metres; a walkway takes you into the heart of the falls, before a stairway leads up to look down on it from above. Optional: the Bird Park after the falls.

provenance.rationale: Removed the Word day indicator while retaining the approved Day 7 text verbatim, including the optional Bird Park.
